comments.author: Sophia
comments.body:
Greetings,
I wanted to give you all an update
on what has happened in regards to
the survey that we performed
recently. Before doing so, I really
would like to thank all of you who
took the time to complete it. We had
around 600 people in the end who
have provided us with lots of
valuable information that we will be
using in the coming weeks to assist
us in resolving the issues at hand.
We in the CJ UWO Ops team have
already reviewed the major issues
and come up with solutions that we
believe the players will be happy
with. We are currently discussing
these with KOEI and will keep you
informed of our progress. Some
issues are easier to fix than others
mainly depending on the amount of
work involved for the development
team, so please understand that we
need to schedule in these changes,
but for those that do not require
such action, we hope to demonstrate
the changes as soon as we possibly
can.
I will endeavor to keep you all
informed as we progress in this
matter. If there are any comments
or concerns please send them to
unit-uwo@cjgamesglobal.com ,
Include “ATTN: Para” in the subject
line, and I will get back to you.
~CJ_Para
